best_section.where: the row of marked bays nearest the pin, backed by the dense tree line along the railway corridor to the north

drivers.seclusion: Backs directly onto a tree-screened rail corridor; closest houses are across Alderson Street, roughly 60 m away and partly screened by trees and sheds. The car park is a known public amenity, so it gets some passing attention, and the roundabout road to the east has a sightline across the open bays.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed, line-marked commuter car park with wide bays and full turning room; entrance off Alderson Street. No gate or boom visible in either image.
drivers.traffic: Alderson Street itself is quiet, but this reads as a train station car park (tracks run along the north edge), so daytime commuter traffic is likely even if it empties out at night.
drivers.convention: Not applicable: this is an off-street car park, not a kerb.
